sentences.text: The Star Trek film series is the cinematic branch of the Star Trek media franchise , which began in 1966 as a weekly television series on NBC , running for three seasons until it was canceled in 1969 because of poor ratings .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	media franchise	media franchise	television series	Star Trek: The Original Series	NBC	NBC

Reruns of the series proved to be wildly successful in syndication during the 1970s , which persuaded the series ' then-owner , Paramount Pictures , to expand the franchise .	Paramount Pictures	Paramount Pictures
Paramount originally began work on a Star Trek feature film in 1975 after lobbying by the creator of the franchise , Gene Roddenberry .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Gene Roddenberry	Gene Roddenberry

The studio scrapped the project two years later in favor of creating a television series , Star Trek : Phase II , with the original cast .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	television series	Star Trek: The Original Series

However , following the huge success of Star Wars and Close Encounters of the Third Kind in 1977 , Paramount changed its mind again , halting production on the television series and adapting its pilot episode into a Star Trek feature film , Star Trek : The Motion Picture -LRB- 1979 -RRB- . Five more Star Trek feature films featuring the entire original cast followed .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)
The cast of the 1987 -- 1994 Star Trek spin-off series Star Trek : The Next Generation starred in a further four films .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)

After a 6-year hiatus following the release of Star Trek : Nemesis -LRB- 2002 -RRB- , a new film was released on May 16 , 2009 , simply titled Star Trek , serving as a reboot to the franchise with a new cast portraying younger versions of the original series ' characters . A sequel to Star Trek -LRB- 2009 -RRB- , Star Trek Into Darkness , was released in theaters on May 16 , 2013 .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Star Trek Into Darkness	Star Trek Into Darkness
A second sequel , Star Trek Beyond , was released on July 22 , 2016 , on the franchise 's 50th anniversary .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Star Trek Beyond	Star Trek Beyond
The Star Trek films have received 15 Academy Award nominations .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Academy Award	Academy Awards

Star Trek -LRB- 2009 -RRB- won for Best Makeup in 2010 , and four of the previous films were nominated mainly in the areas of makeup , music , set design and sound design .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Best Makeup	Academy Award for Best Makeup	2010	82nd Academy Awards

The early Star Trek films , the first to tenth film , were originally released on VHS ; competitive pricing of The Wrath of Khans videocassette helped bolster the adoption of VHS players in households .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	VHS	VHS
Later films were also released on LaserDisc as well .	LaserDisc	LaserDisc
For those films that did not receive an initial DVD release , Paramount released simple one-disc versions with no special features .	DVD	DVD
